JWT Encoder / Decoder

Create real HS256-signed JWTs in your browser and decode/verify existing tokens, all client-side.

Uses the secret above for verification. Leave the secret empty to decode only.

📖 How to use

      
  1. Edit the header and payload JSON.
  2. Type your HS256 secret and click Sign JWT.
  3. Or paste a token below to decode and verify it.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How is the token signed?
Header and payload JSON are base64url-encoded and signed with HMAC-SHA256 using your secret via WebCrypto.
Can I decode a token without the secret?
Yes — paste any token and it decodes the header/payload; with the secret it also checks the signature.
Is my secret sent anywhere?
No. Signing and verification happen locally with the WebCrypto API; tokens never leave your device.
